prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: a valuation came in low. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 1)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"If a surveyor's valuation is lower than the agreed purchase price, we will review the evidence submitted and explain the basis of the valuation. Where appropriate, we may ask for a reconsideration if there is material information that has not been taken into account. Any lending decision remains subject to our underwriting requirements."},{"type":"fact","content":"A low valuation does not automatically mean the application will be declined. If the valuation affects the loan-to-value ratio, the borrower may need to reduce the advance or increase the deposit."},{"type":"fact","content":"Where a valuation comes in below the purchase price, we will notify the applicant and their broker, if applicable, as soon as practicable.
